name: Mahou Shoujo Ai San
source:
Ai and Akitoshi lose a battle against Sin and Megu, their friend, is kidnapped by him. They try to find her, but she is still missing.... One day, Yukari, Akitoshi's friend, appears in front of him and the story gradually goes forward....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081227082538/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011756]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
愛與明人敗給了辛，朋友梅格也被他擄走。兩人四處尋找，卻始終不見她的蹤影……一天，明人的朋友望月紫出現在他面前，故事也由此漸漸展開……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081227082538/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011756]Eroge Shop[/url]]
